steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ use the words a booking runs on — enquiry, available, book, confirm, include, per
✓ wrap a question politely — Could you tell me whether…?
✓ get the word order right inside an indirect question
✓ make a request as politely as possible — I’d be grateful if you could…
✓ avoid repeating yourself — one, ones, do so, that, there
✓ write a formal email of enquiry with the right opening and sign-off
